notes.title: Update 2017/06/10 BRAND NEW VERSION online now!
notes.content:
BRAND NEW VERSION online now! 
New exciting features:
	The dealer gives out cards one by one in the way dealers in real-world do.
	You can observe what others are doing with their chips and cards during the game.
	Chips and cards could move smoothly on the table rather than just teleport, and all chips will fly to the winner at the end of each round.
	Rather than just click, you can pull all chips into the center chips pool as the action of All in, just throw your cards forward as the action of Fold.
	You knock the table as the action of Check now instead of picking up the chip with a zero sign.
	The cards can naturally bent as you pick them up.
	You can also adjust the volume of the background music, the live chat vioce and the system audio effect by pressing the menu button on your VR stick.
	An easter egg left to you guys to find out!
